$comment: Advisories intentionally tolerated while the app is pinned to next@16.2.6, the highest Next version the deprecated @cloudflare/next-on-pages (peer 'next: >=14.3.0 && <=15.5.2') can actually build. The blocking CI audit (.github/audit-gate.mjs) still fails on any critical NOT listed here.
reason: Staying on Cloudflare Pages via next-on-pages. Patched Next (>=16.3.3) fails the Pages build because next-on-pages bundles @vercel/next@4.12.4, which cannot emit Next 16.3 output.
removal_condition: Resolve by migrating off next-on-pages to OpenNext or vinext on Workers, then bumping next to a patched >=16.3.x and emptying this allowlist.
